findings: Stale config snapshot in running NetworkInterceptor: NetworkInterceptor stores the config object at construction time. After AppLens.initialize() replaces this.config, the running interceptor still reads the original redactHeaders list because attachInterceptors() reuses the existing instance without updating its config field. Fix: sync config forward in attachInterceptors() — this.networkInterceptor.config = this.config — before calling attach().

Export name diverges from plan: Library exports AppLensUI; plan specifies AppLensDebugUI. The README and App.tsx integration both use the non-plan name. Low severity — tsc passes and the individual components (AppLensProvider, AppLensTrigger, AppLensModal) are also exported — but callers following the plan's documentation will find the wrong export name.
